items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He said, “We’re on it,” back and forth with e-mail.

ctx.x: I’m sure Ronan Guilfoyle has tales to tell.

He said, “We’re on it,” back and forth with e-mail. He said we don’t have to worry about it. “Yeah, but by the time we’re in Sao Paolo, you’ve got to give me a yes or no.” We got to know two years in advance. Anyway, that’s been very, very interesting and broadening, and of course there’s a real practical level of providing work for me. “Can you come to my school?” This became a source of income. My income is half teaching, or more, of clinics. It’s because of these contacts.
What percentage of your work is Europe?
